title: 第2章 指导战
content_zh:
第2章指导战
许景明看他们模样，也猜到这些年轻人心中想法，微笑道：“我看过你们的资料，如今江南省省队用长枪的一共十一位，这次全来齐了。你们中有三位是高中生，是被特招的，三个小家伙先依次来吧，披甲。”
武道比赛，必须披甲戴头盔，甚至护脖等等一概不能少。
冷兵器格斗，不开锋，且包裹有缓冲层材料，但冲击力依旧恐怖。没专业性设备，是会死人的。
许景明也披甲，头盔戴上，透过面部网格看着这些队员们。
“都进场内。”许景明手持长枪，沿着铁网门走进擂台场内，十一名队员和领队刘教练也走了进来。
“其他人都站边上，冯宇先来，刘豪准备。”许景明说道。
正规比赛擂台内应该仅有两名对战选手，但这仅仅只是指导战，二十米乘二十米的范围……对许景明而言，指点省队队员，根本没必要那么大地方，所以让其他队员也进来旁观。在场内没有铁丝网阻碍，观看的也能更清楚。
“都看清楚了，你们的枪法能有许教练一半水准，就能杀进世界武道大赛了。”领队刘冲远说道，其他队员们也都屏息仔细看着，近距离看到枪魔许景明这种高手出手，也是非常难得的。
一名少年也披甲手持长枪，走到许景明对面，彼此相距十米。
“裁判系统，开启。”许景明说道。
擂台上方降下光影，凝聚成一张巨大面庞俯瞰下方，开口道：“比赛开始。”
现如今武道大赛都是智能裁判，智能裁判摄像头可以放慢千倍，能准确判罚，至今从无出错。
“来吧。”许景明看着这稚嫩少年‘冯宇’，被特招的高中生一般相对都比较弱，只是因为潜力够大才被特招，被重点培养。
“教练小心，我参加比赛时，很多选手都是接不住我一枪。”稚嫩少年冯宇颇为自信。
“有本事你先碰到我再说。”许景明揶揄道。
冯宇很自信地猛然迈步，速度极快，凶猛无比，仅仅几步便冲到近前，前冲势头转为手中长枪一刺，空气都刺出呼啸声。
这一进步刺枪，冯宇每天都要练五百下，每一下都是全力以赴，从十二岁那年开始练枪，五年时间，如今这一枪刺出快如残影，便是厚实铁甲都能刺穿！即便比赛用枪，枪头是圆润的，且有缓冲层包裹，但冲击力依旧有超过八百斤力道。
“轰！”都能清晰听到这一刺枪撕裂风的声音，但许景明却仅仅只退了一步。
长枪枪头，在距离许景明二十公分位置停下，根本没碰到许景明。

“嗯？”冯宇微微一怔，立即枪法一转，化作枪圈，枪尖点点，点向许景明。
每一枪头点下，都是威胁颇大的攻击，但许景明宛如狸猫，简单的移步，便让所有刺枪都落了空。
“省队中的高中生。”许景明想起当年的自己，当年自己也是这般稚嫩。
“他不是腿伤严重，步法很弱吗？怎么我都碰不到他，每次都只差二三十公分？”冯宇不甘心连连出手进攻，枪法眼花缭乱，但就是碰不到许景明分毫。
待得数十枪后，一直移动的许景明第一次出手了，手中长枪抬起，碰触到冯宇怒刺出的长枪刹那，许景明手中长枪枪影模糊了下，陡然爆发出恐怖爆发力。
“嘭！”
低沉的撞击声音，是枪杆撞击的声音，冯宇手中的长枪直接抛飞了出去。
冯宇眼睛瞪得滚圆，握枪的双手都在发颤，他愣愣看着跌落在远处地上的长枪：“我单手至少两百斤的握力，怎么可能一碰就脱手了？”
刚才他可是双手握着长枪，枪杆仅仅一次碰撞，他双手一麻，长枪便飞出去了。
“有些花里胡哨了，你的步法很弱，枪法一般。”许景明评价道，这种对手都不值得他全身披甲，但武道赛事容不得大意，大意可能就后悔一辈子。
“枪法我不太懂。”一旁的领队教练刘冲远哈哈笑道，“但这小子步法是弱，在我们眼中，就跟慢动作一样。”
冯宇有些疑惑看着许景明：“教练，即便我步法弱，可我手持两米多长枪，怎么碰都不碰到你？”
“你的手臂以及长枪，也就这么长。攻击最大距离是固定的。”许景明解释说道，“根据你的步伐，就能确定你长枪能碰触到的最大范围，只要保持距离，就能让你根本碰不到。这是职业选手的基本功。”
“攻击最大距离是固定的？保持距离，就碰不到？”冯宇喃喃低语，他刚才就感觉到了，许景明移动很简单，但自己施展尽了枪法就是碰不到。
“步法的精髓，一是神经反应，二是空间的把握，三是身体平衡的控制。”许景明说道，“你这三方面都很粗糙，就像你们刘教练说的，你的步法，在职业级眼中，就跟慢动作一样。”
“这小子高考结束后，刚招进的省队。”一旁刘冲远说道，“一身野路子，步伐方面是得狠狠练。”
冯宇连追问：“许教练，那我的枪法有哪些问题？”
步法弱，他认。
但枪法是他最自信的。
“你的枪法……严格说，只有开始的一记刺枪，将身体前冲的整劲都凝聚那一枪中，算是有职业级水准。其他的戳枪、崩劈、格挡等方面都很弱。”许景明说道，兵器格斗不是过家家，是最凶险的格斗，重伤残疾都偶有发生，既然自己当他们教练，就得将他们的问题说清楚。

其他十名队员都感到了许景明的压迫力，同时也跃跃欲试。
“嘭。”第二名高中生手中长枪，在和许景明长枪碰触的刹那，也抛飞了出去。即便做好准备，努力想要握紧，努力卸力也是没用。
“嘭”“嘭”“嘭”“嘭”“嘭”“嘭”……
一杆又一杆长枪，接连抛飞！
这些省队队员们都目瞪口呆。
包括那两名参加过国家集训队的老选手黄风、章奇在内，在许景明面前都毫无还手之力。
其中，仅有章奇让许景明出了两枪！第一枪将章奇手中长枪荡开，章奇倒是努力握住了长枪，没有飞出去，但也中门大开，许景明的第二枪便顺势刺在章奇胸口，冲击力令甲衣亮起红灯，章奇输了！
其他队员们，许景明都只是出了一枪！且还是防御格挡的一枪，那些队员们的长枪便都抛飞出去，根本握不住。
“这就是枪魔？”
“世界武道大赛举办至今近三十年，论枪法，历史上所有职业选手，许景明公认排在前十，虽然想象过，可交手才发现，差距太大了！”
“枪魔许景明，最为出名的绝招是‘无影刺’，但面对我们根本不需要施展那等绝招。”
“如果枪法能达到他的一半，便足以杀进世界武道大赛了吧。”
这些队员们眼神又激动又狂热。
亲身体会，才能明白，历史前十的枪法是何等恐怖。甚至他们觉得，枪魔许景明应该依旧保持着巅峰时实力，甚至说比巅峰时更强些都有可能！
两个小时后。
“今天的初步训练，相信大家都清楚自身的缺陷。”许景明看着省队队员，队员们也个个兴奋狂热，觉得这次培训真的太值了。
“在接下来九天时间，每天会重点进行一项基础训练，等集训结束，你们回去也要每日加练。枪法是需要经年累月去练的，全身的力道自然转入每一枪，需要悟性，也需要苦练。”许景明说道。
“是，教练。”十一名队员都齐声应道，显然个个对许景明心服口服，且崇拜。
“好，解散。”许景明点头道。
“你们先坐车回酒店。”一旁领队刘冲远吩咐道。

“好嘞。”这些队员们个个放下兵器，三三两两一同离去。
“阿晨，带刘教练去坐会儿。”许景明说道，“大熊，我这一身臭汗，先去洗澡换身衣服，等会儿楼下汇合，我们格斗馆旁边的烤肉餐厅，是我在滨海市最喜欢的一家烤肉餐厅。”
“哦？那可要好好尝尝。”体型宛如大熊的刘冲远也颇为期待，他们这些职业选手训练量大，吃得也多，个个喜好肉食。
许景明则是赶紧去洗澡，两个小时训练，虽然是教练，但许景明全身早就湿透了。不过他也习惯了，武道训练，衣服湿透挤干，再湿透再挤干都是很常见的事。
许景明冲洗完，又换了短袖大裤衩走出来，一眼看到在门外抽烟的中年男子。
“师兄，你怎么来了？”许景明惊讶笑道，眼前这人名叫方星龙，是星空格斗馆的老板！星空格斗馆是滨海市一流格斗馆，建筑面积超过11000平米，许景明一个职业武道选手可没这么大手笔，他是被请来当馆主的。
方星龙主业是卖酒的，是身家数十亿的老板，酷爱武道兵器格斗，舍得砸钱，在武道圈子内也算颇有名气，也拜在了“凶虎”柳海名下。
世界武道大赛创建至今近三十年，柳海担当国家队主教练这个位置足足二十年，国家队队员们大多数都得称呼他一声师父。
第一届世界武道大赛时，柳海就已经四十五岁了，作为老一辈的武道名家，发现这等大赛欣喜若狂，他连续杀进了五届世界武道大赛，和来自世界各地的高手们去拼！早期因为保护规则不够完善，比现在赛事更危险。柳海拿过两次第三，两次第二，以及一次世界第一！拿到世界第一后，他才宣布退役，五十岁那年担当国家队主教练，七十岁时才宣布退休。
许景明当年是国家队主力，也是柳海的爱徒。方星龙是业余选手，但无比喜爱格斗，也想方设法拜在柳海门下。
“景明。”方星龙抽着烟，看了眼自己的好兄弟，“你是不是得罪人了？”
content_en:
Chapter 2 Guidance Battle
Looking at their appearance, Xu Jingming guessed the thoughts of these young people, and said with a smile: "I have read your information. There are now eleven spearmen in the Jiangnan Provincial Team, and they are all here this time. Three of you are high school students and were specially recruited. The three little guys will come first, wearing armor."
In martial arts competitions, you must wear armor, a helmet, and even a neck protector.
It's a cold weapon fight, it doesn't open the front, and it's wrapped with a buffer layer of material, but the impact is still terrifying. Without professional equipment, people will die.
Xu Jingming also wore armor and a helmet, looking at the team members through the facial mesh.
"Everyone come into the arena." Xu Jingming held a long gun and walked into the arena along the iron gate. Eleven players and the team leader Coach Liu also walked in.
"Everyone else is standing aside. Feng Yu will come first, and Liu Hao will prepare." Xu Jingming said.
There should be only two opponents in the regular competition arena, but this is just a coaching battle, with an area of ​​20 meters by 20 meters... For Xu Jingming, there is no need for such a big place to coach the provincial team members, so he let other team members come in to watch. There is no barbed wire obstruction in the venue, so you can watch more clearly.
"I have seen clearly. If your marksmanship is half as good as Coach Xu's, you will be able to enter the World Martial Arts Competition." Team leader Liu Chongyuan said. The other team members also watched carefully with bated breath. It is also very rare to see a master like Gun Demon Xu Jingming take action at close range.
A young man, also wearing armor and holding a spear, walked across from Xu Jingming, ten meters away from each other.
"Referee system, turn on." Xu Jingming said.
Light and shadow descended from the top of the ring, condensing into a huge face looking down, and said: "The game begins."
Nowadays, martial arts competitions are all equipped with intelligent referees. The intelligent referee cameras can slow down a thousand times and accurately judge penalties. So far, they have never made any mistakes.
"Come on." Xu Jingming looked at the immature boy 'Feng Yu'. High school students who were specially recruited were generally relatively weak. They were specially recruited and focused on training because they had great potential.
"Coach, be careful. When I participated in the competition, many players couldn't catch my shot." Feng Yu, a young boy, is quite confident.
"If you have the ability, you can meet me first," Xu Jingming teased.
Feng Yu stepped forward confidently, extremely fast and fiercely. He rushed forward in just a few steps, and the forward momentum turned into a stab with the spear in his hand, which made a whistling sound in the air.
Feng Yu has to practice this advanced spear spear five hundred times every day, and he goes all out for every shot. He started practicing spear spear when he was twelve years old. In five years, this spear thrust is as fast as an afterimage, and it can pierce even thick iron armor! Even if it is a competition gun, the gun head is rounded and wrapped with a buffer layer, but the impact force is still over 800 kilograms.
"Boom!" Everyone could clearly hear the sound of the stabbing spear tearing through the wind, but Xu Jingming only took a step back.
The spearhead stopped twenty centimeters away from Xu Jingming, without touching Xu Jingming at all.
"Huh?" Feng Yu was slightly startled, and immediately changed his spear technique, turning it into a circle of spears. The tip of the spear pointed at Xu Jingming.
Every nod of the spear head was a threatening attack, but Xu Jingming was like a civet cat, making all the spears miss with a simple movement.
"A high school student in the provincial team." Xu Jingming thought of himself back then, how immature he was back then.
"Didn't he have a serious leg injury and weak footwork? How come I can't touch him, only missing him by twenty or thirty centimeters every time?" Feng Yu was unwilling to attack again and again. His marksmanship was dazzling, but he couldn't touch Xu Jingming at all.
After waiting for dozens of shots, Xu Jingming, who had been moving, took action for the first time. He raised the spear in his hand and touched the spear thrust out by Feng Yunu. The shadow of the spear in Xu Jingming's hand blurred for a moment, and a terrifying explosive force suddenly erupted.
"Bang!"
The low impact sound was the sound of the gun barrel hitting, and the long gun in Feng Yu's hand was thrown away.
FengYu's eyes widened, and his hands holding the gun were trembling. He stared blankly at the spear that fell to the ground in the distance: "I have a grip strength of at least 200 kilograms with one hand, how could it be possible for me to lose my grip with just one touch?"
Just now, he was holding the spear with both hands. The barrel of the gun only collided once. His hands went numb and the spear flew out.
"It's a bit fancy. Your footwork is weak and your marksmanship is average." Xu Jingming commented that this kind of opponent is not worthy of him wearing armor, but there is no room for carelessness in martial arts competitions. If you are careless, you may regret it for the rest of your life.
"I don't know much about marksmanship." Liu Chongyuan, the team coach on the side, laughed, "But this kid's footwork is weak. In our eyes, it's like slow motion."
Feng Yu looked at Xu Jingming with some confusion: "Coach, even if my footwork is weak, I am holding a two-meter-long spear and I can't touch you no matter what?"
"Your arm and spear are only so long. The maximum attack distance is fixed." Xu Jingming explained, "According to your pace, you can determine the maximum range that your spear can touch. As long as you keep the distance, you can't touch it at all. This is the basic skill of professional players."
"Is the maximum attack distance fixed? If you keep the distance, you can't touch him?" Feng Yu murmured. He had felt it just now. Xu Jingming moved easily, but he couldn't touch him even though he used all his marksmanship.
"The essence of footwork is, first, nerve response, second, grasp of space, and third, control of body balance." Xu Jingming said, "You are very rough in these three aspects. As your coach Liu said, your footwork, in the eyes of a professional, is like slow motion."
"This guy was just recruited into the provincial team after the college entrance examination." Liu Chongyuan said from the side, "He has a wild style, so he needs to practice his steps very hard."
Feng Yulian asked: "Coach Xu, what are the problems with my marksmanship?"
His footwork is weak, he admits.
But his marksmanship is what he is most confident about.
"Your marksmanship... Strictly speaking, only the first stabbing shot, where all the energy of the body's forward thrust is concentrated in that one shot, is considered to be at a professional level. The other aspects of stabbing, slashing, blocking, etc. are very weak." Xu Jingming said, weapons fighting is not a trick, it is the most dangerous fighting, and serious injuries and disabilities occasionally occur. Since he is their coach, he must explain their problems clearly.
The other ten team members all felt Xu Jingming's pressure and were eager to try.
"Bang." The spear in the second high school student's hand was thrown away the moment it came into contact with Xu Jingming's spear. Even if you are prepared, try hard to hold on, and try hard to release the force, it is useless.
"Bang" "Bang" "Bang" "Bang" "Bang" "Bang"...
One long spear after another was thrown away one after another!
The provincial team members were stunned.
Including the two veteran players Huang Feng and Zhang Qi who had participated in the national training team, none of them had the power to fight back in front of Xu Jingming.
Among them, only Zhang Qi allowed Xu Jingming to fire two shots! The first shot knocked the spear away from Zhang Qi's hand. Zhang Qi managed to hold on to the spear without flying out, but the door was still wide open. Xu Jingming's second shot stabbed Zhang Qi in the chest. The impact caused the armor to light up in red. Zhang Qi lost!
The other team members, Xu Jingming only fired one shot! Moreover, it was a defensive shot, and all the spears of the team members were thrown away, unable to hold it at all.
"Is this the Gun Demon?"
"The World Martial Arts Competition has been held for nearly 30 years. In terms of marksmanship, Xu Jingming is recognized to be in the top ten of all professional players in history. Although I had imagined it, I found out after fighting that the gap is too big!"
"The gun demon Xu Jingming's most famous trick is the 'Shadowless Thorn', but there is no need to use that trick when facing us."
"If my marksmanship can reach even half of his, it will be enough to enter the World Martial Arts Competition."
The eyes of these team members were excited and enthusiastic.
Only by experiencing it yourself can you understand how terrifying the top ten marksmen in history are. They even think thatGun Demon Xu Jingming should still maintain the strength at his peak, and may even be stronger than at his peak!
Two hours later.
"In today's preliminary training, I believe everyone is aware of their own shortcomings." Xu Jingming looked at the provincial team members. They were all excited and enthusiastic, feeling that this training was really worth it.
"In the next nine days, we will focus on one basic training every day. When the training is over, you will have to practice more every day when you go back. Marksmanship requires years of practice. The strength of the whole body is naturally transferred into each shot. It requires understanding and hard practice." Xu Jingming said.
"Yes, coach." All eleven team members responded in unison, obviously all of them were convinced and admired Xu Jingming.
"Okay, dismissal." Xu Jingming nodded.
"You guys take the car back to the hotel first." Team leader Liu Chongyuan ordered from the side.
"Okay." Each of these team members put down their weapons and left together in twos and threes.
"Ah Chen, take Coach Liu to sit for a while." Xu Jingming said, "Big Bear, I'm stinking of sweat. I'll go take a shower and change clothes first. We'll meet downstairs later. The barbecue restaurant next to our fighting gym is my favorite barbecue restaurant in Binhai City."
"Oh? Then I have to try it." Liu Chongyuan, who is like a big bear, is also looking forward to it. They, professional players, train a lot and eat a lot, and they all like meat.
Xu Jingming quickly went to take a shower and trained for two hours. Although he was a coach, Xu Jingming's whole body was already soaked. But he is also used to it. During martial arts training, it is very common for clothes to get wet and squeezed dry, then get wet again and squeezed dry again.
After Xu Jingming finished rinsing, he changed into short-sleeved pants and shorts and walked out. He saw a middle-aged man smoking outside the door.
"Brother, why are you here?" Xu Jingming said with a surprised smile. The man in front of him is named Fang Xinglong, and he is the owner of the Star Fighting Gym! The Starry Sky Fighting Gym is a first-class fighting gym in Binhai City, with a construction area of ​​more than 11,000 square meters. Xu Jingming, a professional martial arts player, is not so generous, so he was invited to be the owner of the gym.
Fang Xinglong's main business is selling liquor. He is a boss worth billions. He loves fighting with martial arts weapons and is willing to spend money. He is quite famous in the martial arts circle and is also under the name of "Fierce Tiger" Liu Hai.
It has been nearly thirty years since the World Martial Arts Competition was founded. Liu Hai has been the head coach of the national team for twenty years. Most of the national team members have to call him master.
Liu Hai was already forty-five years old when the first World Martial Arts Competition was held. As an older generation of martial arts masters, he was ecstatic to find such competitions. He entered five consecutive World Martial Arts Competitions and competed with masters from all over the world! In the early days, because the protection rules were not perfect, the competition was more dangerous than it is now. Liu Hai has finished third twice, second twice, and first in the world once! He announced his retirement only after he became number one in the world. He became the head coach of the national team when he was 50 years old and announced his retirement when he was 70 years old.
Xu Jingming was the main player of the national team and Liu Hai's disciple. Fang Xinglong is an amateur player, but he loves fighting very much and tries his best to become Liu Hai's disciple.
"Jing Ming." Fang Xinglong smoked a cigarette and glanced at his good brother, "Did you offend someone?"
